name: Deck manipulations
author: Campaign
description: The card-and-deck feat manipulations a cardcaster picks from.

cardcasting.source: http://spheresofpower.wikidot.com/card-and-deck-feats — Deck Feats: 'For every deck feat a character possesses, they may also select a special deck manipulation from the following list.'

manipulations.name: Deck Ripper
manipulations.text: If you have multiple identical cards in your hand, you may reveal any number of cards which are identical to each other and discard all but one of them, drawing cards equal to the number of cards discarded.

manipulations.name: Dedicating Summons
manipulations.text: As long as you and a summoned companion have both line of sight and line of effect to each other, the companion may spend a full-round action to add one additional Mana Point Card to the number you have in play for the purpose of spending spell points, until the start of your next turn. Each further pick adds one more Mana Point Card.

manipulations.name: Drawpower Enhancement
manipulations.text: By spending a spell point as a free action once per round, you may shuffle one card from your hand into your deck. If you do, draw 2 cards — 3 if you take this deck manipulation a second time.

manipulations.name: Extra Deck
manipulations.text: When you rest to regain spell points, choose five cards from your deck and place them face-down beside it: your Extra Deck. Spend a spell point as a free action to draw a card from it, or two to search it for a card. Each further pick adds five more cards.

manipulations.name: Fresh Hand
manipulations.text: At the start of your turn, shuffle your hand into your deck and draw a number of cards equal to the number you may draw at the beginning of an encounter. You may spend a spell point to keep a single card from your previous hand, plus one more for every 5 points of MSB; for each kept card, draw one fewer. (Addendum: may instead be used at the beginning of each initiative round, chosen when taken.)

manipulations.name: Fused Cards
manipulations.text: When you build your deck, choose a number of cards up to your casting ability modifier. Each may have one additional magic effect printed on it (Mana Point Cards included); when played, choose which one effect takes effect. The same card may be chosen again, up to five effects on one card. Each further pick chooses another casting-modifier's worth of cards.

manipulations.name: Impulse
manipulations.text: Once per round as a free action, you may exile the top card of your deck. If you do, you may use that card as if it was played from your hand before the start of your next turn.

manipulations.name: Into Nothing
manipulations.text: As a free action which can be taken outside of your turn, you may discard any number of cards from your hand.

manipulations.name: Life Draw
manipulations.text: As a free action once per round, you may deal yourself nonlethal damage equal to half your character level (minimum 1) to draw a card. This damage cannot be avoided, reduced or healed except by rest.

manipulations.name: Loaded Hand
manipulations.text: At the start of combat, draw 2 additional cards. May be selected any number of times.

manipulations.name: Mulligan
manipulations.text: The first time each encounter you shuffle and redraw your card casting hand, you may draw the same number of cards as before rather than one fewer.

manipulations.name: Primed Hand
manipulations.text: When you spend a standard or full-round action to target only yourself with a magic sphere effect, you may spend a spell point to draw one card for every 3 caster levels of the effect (minimum 1).

manipulations.name: Prize Card
manipulations.text: Whenever you reduce a creature of at least half your CR to 0 hit points or knock such a creature unconscious from nonlethal damage, draw a card.

manipulations.name: Rapid Fill
manipulations.text: As a swift action, you may draw a card.

manipulations.name: Read the Cards
manipulations.text: As a free action even outside of your turn, look at the top card of your deck; spend a spell point to put it on the bottom. Usable a number of times per round up to your deck feats, and before you draw each round. Taken twice: look at the top 3, and discard any of them or arrange them on top or bottom.

manipulations.name: Readied Renewal
manipulations.text: Whenever you recharge a charged sphere effect, you may return a single card corresponding to that effect from your graveyard to your hand.

manipulations.name: Recollection
manipulations.text: You may discard two cards from your hand to put a card from your discard pile into your hand. Whenever you would draw a card, you may instead discard a card from your hand to draw the top card of your discard pile.

manipulations.name: Resupply
manipulations.text: As a move action, you may put a Mana Point Card from your discard pile into your hand.

manipulations.name: Retrace
manipulations.text: You may spend an additional spell point or increase the casting time by one step in order to cast any magic effect from a card in your discard pile.

manipulations.name: Shield Card
manipulations.text: Whenever any creature's temporary hit points from invigorate are reduced to 0, draw a card.

manipulations.name: Sideboard
manipulations.text: When you rest to regain spell points, choose one card from your deck; it stays face-up beside the deck, may be cast at any time, and returns there whenever it would be discarded or shuffled in. Each further pick sideboards another card.

manipulations.name: Trimmed Deck
manipulations.text: Your minimum deck size is reduced by 4 (to a minimum of 1). May be selected multiple times.

manipulations.name: Wild Card
manipulations.text: Each pick adds a card to your deck denoted as the wild card. When you play it, search your deck for any one other card and put it into your hand, then shuffle the wild card back in.

manipulations.name: Blooming
manipulations.text: Specialized Mana Card: this Mana Point Card provides the use of three spell points, but is discarded at the end of any turn it is used.

manipulations.name: Consumptive
manipulations.text: Specialized Mana Card: as a free action, discard this card to make another creature within close range discard a single Mana Point Card.

manipulations.name: Dual-Color
manipulations.text: Specialized Mana Card: this Mana Point Card has two colours rather than one (chosen when it goes in the deck) for the purpose of what effects it can pay for.

manipulations.name: Mana Rock
manipulations.text: Specialized Mana Card: treats your MSD as 5 higher against dispels of the card. With Gradual Ramp, you may spend a spell point as a free action to play a mana rock even if you have already played a Mana Point Card this turn.

manipulations.name: Matched Set
manipulations.text: Specialized Mana Card: two matched set cards in play count as four Mana Point Cards, three as seven. Past three, further ones start a new set. Under Colored Mana a set is all one colour.

manipulations.name: Moxen
manipulations.text: Specialized Mana Card: may be played from your hand even if you have already played a Mana Point Card this turn. Only one Moxen per colour in the deck.

manipulations.name: Neo-Moxen
manipulations.text: Specialized Mana Card: a Mana Point Card of all colours, under one restriction chosen when taken (only counts while you have a summoned creature; only counts with three or more effects active; or, with Control Caster, Warp and Cooldown, only playable by exiling a card from your hand).

manipulations.name: Planar Alliance
manipulations.text: Specialized Mana Card: counts as one Mana Point Card for every Conjuration sphere companion you have summoned (minimum 0).

manipulations.name: Type Exchange
manipulations.text: Specialized Mana Card: spend a swift action to change this card's colour until the start of your next turn.

manipulations.name: Wasting
manipulations.text: Specialized Mana Card: put this card from play into your discard pile to make another Mana Point Card in play go to its controller's discard pile (or be shuffled into their deck).
